728-2317-7084-8345.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

1939-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-7918.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-7918.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Sifa Grent and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4770-6090-6723-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-1472-3899-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-3899-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

650-3175-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

141-6929-8095.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-3845-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

997-4640-8032--201.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2292-3184-4766--190.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger.
Repeat.

4222-6006-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3492-3609-4112-7715.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

4681-5170-6797-7452.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1417-2511-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-6249-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2

457-777-1329-3338-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2292-5702-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4771-5660-6747.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

57-4785-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4785-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4549-5051-5078-5741.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

826-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2281-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2281-5971.description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
When Saffi Eriksdotter dies, Yedora triggers, returning Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Saffi Eriksdotter enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Saffi Eriksdotter by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Saffi Eriksdotter face-up.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1621-3556-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
1621-3556-4605.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

101-2103-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Vampire Charmseeker each turn.
101-2103-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Vampire Charmseeker from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

345-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
345-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

67-2517-4050-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2517-4050-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding one mana of any color.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1459-4499-4893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1459-4499-4893.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galadriel.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose any of Galadriel's modes.

2808-3280.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
2808-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord that is a 1/1 Frog.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.

413-659-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
413-659-2178.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblins enter the batltefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Krenko triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4186-4279-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-4716.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
